notes: Card: ' K' x7, '-K' x2 in the top 32 (Kuhn, KISSINGER, Banjo-Kazooie), plus Cyrillic, Arabic and Korean K sounds. Probes: 'Thomas Kuhn' 0.60, 'Banjo-Kazooie' 0.66; Kubrick, Kafka, Kant, Kissinger, Kong, Kierkegaard, Kim, Kowalski and 'Vitamin K' all under 0.04.
